author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
A sequel to the original CTF map, Boolean. Quite a lot has been changed, and it's loosely based off of "Infinity Loop" from Avalanche Network. You have 2 wools to capture and bring back: purple and pink, cyan and light blue. Pretty straightforward with the gamemode as Boolean currently plays, just a more complicated map layout.

I've never seen any map on Avicus have a layout like this, so we'll see how it ends up. Special thanks to PokerFace and steven5703!
